articles.title: Reliance Retail Q2 profit takes a hit on Qcomm push
articles.content: Reliance Retail Ventures reported a significant drop in net profit, down 24.5% year-on-year to ₹2,619 crore in the last quarter. The company's profitability was affected by strategic investments and evolving festive season patterns, alongside rising finance costs stemming from increased borrowing and interest rates. Focus remains on improving transactions and business model adaptation.

articles.title: Global Markets | European shares stumble at end of best month since June on AI worries

articles.title: Tech rout drives gold to one-year low, white metals sink deep into oversold zone

A decline in demand for silver's industrial and jewelry uses further complicates its market outlook, leaving a persistent downtrend expected.
